referenceRole: Approved PNG boards used as style references only. No concept-board crop is a production asset.

assets.prompt: Original bare complete round cardboard microplanet, genuine alpha, no UI/characters/ship/buildings/flags/clouds. Closed sphere with a broad curved ochre sandy cardboard top, warm-orange paper-block geology and moss at the perimeter, lower hemisphere in violet paper-rock and brass mechanical plating, copper pipes and recessed lower-right amber vent. Fine deliberate pixel clusters, warm upper-left light, cool violet lower-right shadow, no flat floating island or large unshaded blocks.

Original transparent 3-column/2-row production sprite sheet: head only, torso only, scanner forearm only, normal grasping forearm only, left leg only, right leg only. Same cream/lilac shell, brass joints, cyan eyes and scanner lens; approx2.5 heads tall assembled. Warm upper-left light and purple lower-right shadow, no text or ground shadows, clean gutters.

Keep exact six components, positions, scale and details unchanged. Remove broad purple/beige glow, dark haze and background around isolated hard-surface parts. Fully opaque pixel components on completely transparent background. Do not crop, rearrange or merge parts.

One original isolated receiving station: small warm-orange cardboard warehouse, purple beveled roof, copper pipes, cream-and-rose striped awning over LEFT FRONT loading door, warm brass lantern. Isometric front-left and receding right side. Large dark open loading doorway at left, three high windows on right, envelope glyph without letters, tiny rear parcels clear of doorway. No characters/planet/clouds/UI.

Original three-row atlas of independent horizontal volumetric pixel clouds: dark violet BACK, full amethyst BODY with upper-left lavender lobes, pink-lilac FRONT rim. Same pixel scale and light, compact opaque core with short alpha edge feather. No planet, text, nodes, rectangle, enormous haze or generic color blocks.

One original small parcel sorting machine, transparent: squat warm orange chassis, violet top, brass joints, dark FRONT LEFT intake with three short flexible violet curtain flaps, small protruding front-left roller conveyor, four short feet, small right service screen and copper pipe. Isometric front-left view, no building/roof/lamppost/character or extra whole machine.

One original slim security searchlight mast: triangular violet metal braced foot, copper post, brass collars, attached coil wire and purple mechanical bracket. Single brass lamp cyan lens faces LEFT, no beam or aura. Tiny amber signal jewel, high-density pixel art, warm upper-left lighting, isolated genuine alpha.

Original transparent 2x2 atlas with four views of SAME courier spacecraft. Cream/lavender round hull, brass nose trim and rear engine, three cyan cockpit windows, purple fins and orange cargo pods. Top-left rightward side engine at left; top-right front/bow pointing down; bottom-left leftward side engine right; bottom-right stern pointing up with one visible bottom engine mouth. No exhaust, shadow, text or planet. Consistent craft identity, equal scale, clean gutters.

Original quiet navy-plum starfield only, faint violet wisps at edges, restrained cream pixel stars, dark central area for independently rendered planet. No planets/moons/asteroids/floating islands/buildings/ship/nodes/orbits/text/HUD; no unknown world shapes.

Original isolated small tangled jam of cream packing-paper strips with curled edges, bent violet address labels and one unmarked ochre seal, no readable writing or signature. Wide horizontal isometric 3/4 view. Distinct layered folds, clean transparent background, no mud template, box, machine or glow.

Original 3-column/2-row night visitor atlas, alpha. Top row: little orange loose-lid box with two pale eyes, cream-lilac address-label moth with rolled-paper brass body, broad crumpled return-paper visitor with accordion side wings and curled lower strips. Bottom row: same box folded shut, same moth folded wings, same return-paper folded packet. Friendly weird paper creatures, not residents or violent monsters. No UI/text, warm upper-left light, violet shadow and deliberate clustered pixels.

Original transparent three-column production atlas of one handheld glass field containment case: left OPEN case with rear brass rim/back glass/side walls/solid lilac tray, lid and front glass absent; middle matching front glass panel only with restrained right-edge reflection; right matching shallow glass lid with TWO brass grasping handles. Consistent isometric front-left perspective and scale, no specimens/text/arms/ghostly glow, warm brass and violet frame.

Original transparent 2x2 atlas of four existing paid engineering modules, consistent front-left pixel art: low brass docking pad tile with three inset amber lamps, compact violet deep-space receiver with brass antenna and cyan screen, service rack with copper welding arm/wrench/angled repair plate, compact cream-violet courier-engine module with brass nozzle and orange pods. No text/UI/characters or planet. Upper-left warm light, lower-right violet shadow, no haze or ground shadow.

exportNotes: Alpha under128 from generation haze is cleared; hard-surface subject pixels use opaque clustered edges. Glass is separately calibrated to low alpha in registered cavity polygons; frame pixels remain opaque. Parts are cropped only from dedicated original production sources. New full pose atlas is a compatibility fallback, while live robot uses independent head/torso/limbs and true parcel/case hand positions.
